neovoxy.config.title: NeoVoxy
neovoxy.config.general.serviceThreads.to: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
Uses sodium builder threads as part of neovoxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
neovoxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
neovoxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.t: Maximum size in pixels (squared) of screenspace AABB before subdiving to smaller LoDs (Smaller being higher quality)
neovoxy.config.general.renderDistance.to: Render distance of neovoxy in chunks
neovoxy.config.general.environmental_fog: Enables or disables neovoxy rendering environmental fog
neovoxy.config.general.render_fog.toolti: Enables or disables render fog effect
neovoxy.config.general.render_statistics: Enable render statistics in F3 menu, useful for debugging
neovoxy.sodium.page.title: NeoVoxy
neovoxy.sodium.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch to enable or disable the NeoVoxy LOD system
neovoxy.sodium.option.enable_rendering.t: Enable rendering of LOD terrain. Disable to keep data ingestion running without visual output.
neovoxy.sodium.option.ingest_enabled.too: Enable automatic conversion of visited chunks into LOD data
neovoxy.sodium.option.render_distance.to: How far LOD terrain renders. Value is multiplied by 32 to get chunk distance. Example: 16 = 512 chunks.
neovoxy.sodium.option.service_threads.to: Number of background threads for LOD processing. More threads = faster LOD generation but higher CPU usage.
neovoxy.sodium.option.subdivision_size.t: Maximum screen-space size before subdividing to higher detail LODs. Lower = more detail but more GPU work.
Apply environmental fog effects to LOD terrain
neovoxy.sodium.option.dont_use_sodium_th: Don't share threads with Sodium's chunk builder. Enable if you experience stuttering.
neovoxy.sodium.option.lod_boundary_buffe: Controls overlap between vanilla chunks and LODs. Higher = smoother transitions when flying fast, but slight overdraw.
Show LOD render statistics in the F3 debug screen
Simulates standing on a spherical planet. 0 = flat world. Higher values = smaller planet effect (more curvature). Inspired by Distant Horizons.
